$comment: AxiomV2Query as deployed (axiom-crypto/axiom-v2-contracts contracts/query/AxiomV2Query.sol at 5514752e, the V2 mainnet release): on each chain, the ERC-1967 proxy at the registry's address and the UUPS implementation its slot names, read with eth_getCode at the block given on 2026-10-08. The two implementations differ only in the address UUPSUpgradeable keeps as an immutable (their own) and in the compiler's metadata hash. The suite deploys each runtime at its own address, points the proxy at the implementation, and initializes it with the chain's live parameters and the proof mocks beside this file.
